Posted May 30, 2004
Analysis by Richard Cowan sponsored by Advanced Nutrients.
See
The Crisis in Democracy, Prohibitionism And The Police Fiasco. Why Will It Work In Iraq, If It Does Not Work In DEAland?
and
Ethical Failure Of Cannabis Prohibition. Tragedy And Farce. Using the Patients To Protect Prohibition. Analysis by Richard Cowan

Canada is in the midst of an election campaign. (A new parliament will be chosen on June 28th, and it is possible that the Conservatives may win, which would be bad for us, but it is more likely that there will be a Liberal/New Democratic coalition, which might be good.) Naturally, the politicians are crisscrossing the country promising better health care and a more honest and responsive government, etc., and wrapping themselves in the Maple Leaf flag.

However, on Thursday the Canadian government revealed its true nature. The RCMP raided the Vancouver Island Therapeutic Cannabis Research Institute (VITCRI), the research facility of the Vancouver Island Compassion Society (VICS). (See the press release below.)

This outrage demands a meaningful response from Canadian leaders, not just the politicians.

The facility also produced medicine for almost 400 patients, but this was no ordinary grow-op. Far more than most medical cannabis distributors, the VICS is deeply involved in research and development of new medical cannabis products, as well as selective breeding of a variety of strains for various conditions.
From 2001 see
BC Medical Cannabis Greenhouse Busted while Compassion Clubs Consult with Canadian Health Minister Allan Rock

The VICS, under the leadership of Philippe Lucas, has also been the most vocal critic of Health Canada's ludicrous medical cannabis fiasco.
See
We Live In Interesting Times: Chaos in Cannabis Prohibition Around the World. Does John Walters Really Want A National Debate on Marijuana Prohibition?

On April 30th, the VICS issued a press release revealing that over 30% of the eligible patients had returned HC's schwag! It was simply unusable.
(See the press release below)

Less than one month later, the government of Canada moved to silence its critics and destroy the knowledge base of the people who are really doing something to help sick and dying Canadians.

From the beginning of its absurd medical cannabis program it has been clear that the one qualification required by Health Canada was a total lack of knowledge about cannabis.
See
Canadian Health Minister Seeks Asylum In DEAland; Says Making Her Think About Medical Cannabis Constitutes Torture. In DC They Don't Allow That Sort of Thing. Thinking, That Is.

Of course, HC has followed the prohibitionist party line in saying that we need more research on cannabis before we can know if it really helps patients. (Apparently, no such research is required to determine if being arrested helps patients.) But they, like their DEAland mentors, have blocked most research and have ignored the huge data bases developed by the compassion societies.
See
Health Canada's Office of Cannabis Medical Access' Stakeholder Advisory Committee Includes Physicians for A Smoke Free Canada - Not The Compassion Societies. But It Will Let Them Talk For An Hour

In fact, this raid makes all too clear that HC is not merely indifferent to science, but is actively hostile toward any real research that they cannot control.
See
Scientific and Ethical Implications of Dutch Medical Cannabis Program for Health Canada. Does Making Cannabis Available By Prescription Before The Research Is Completed Offer A Way Out?

This raid was not about medicine, or science, or the patients; it was and is about power. It is also an attack on the two fundamental elements of civilization, civility and knowledge.
See
Science, Democracy, Ideology and the Prohibitionist Police State. Marijuana Use Doesn't Hurt Thinking Skills But Prohibition Does. Analysis by Richard Cowan
and
What Is More Important, Prohibition Or The Patients? The Death of Cheryl Miller Should Remind Us All To Demand A Change In Priorities. Should Pain Be A Crime?
and
D oh! Canada? Proposed Marijuana Modernization Equals The Sum of All Their Ignorance. The Intellectual and Moral Bankruptcy of Canadian Cannabis Prohibition. Analysis by Richard Cowan

As Philippe notes in his press release, 90% of Canadians favor medical cannabis, and Canadian courts have repeatedly ruled that patients have a right to access to cannabis. In every way, this is one of the least controversial issues on the Canadian agenda, and yet patients are still being arrested, and growers are subjected to predatory raids. Grant Krieger, the heroic Alberta MS patient has been repeatedly targeted by law enforcement.
See
Marijuana as Medicine and the Law Circa 2001 -- By John W. Conroy, QC --Unabridged Version Special to MarijuanaNews

The same day that the RCMP raided the VITCRI, they also raided a licensed grower on Vancouver Island. It is hardly a coincidence that less than 24 hours before the raid he had gone to the police to get a confirmation that he had no criminal record, so he could renew his grower's license. (He grew for one patient.) Seven armed police destroyed his legal cannabis garden, and they also stole his wife's tomato plants! So we have petty thieves doing the dirty work for petty bureaucrats.
See
Lies Have Consequences. From Prohibitionist Venom to the Harsh Realities of Life and Death for Patients. Swedish Prohibitionists, Canadian Bureaucracy and DEAland Medical Murder.

And the bureaucrats have plenty of real work to do. On May 22nd, the National Post reported, As many as 24,000 patients die in Canadian hospitals each year, while tens of thousands more are crippled, injured or poisoned in association with medical errors that could have been prevented The study, to be published in the Canadian Medical Association Journal, found 185,000 patients a year suffer adverse events.

That is more than double the rate found in studies of U.S. hospitals.

HC can't protect Canadians from incompetent quacks, but it wants to keep total control over the medical cannabis supply.
See
Live Free or Die In Pain. The Ignorance and Arrogance of the Quacks Who Deny Pain Relief to the Sick and Dying.
and
Calling All Quacks: The Therapeutic Police State and the Politicization of Medicine. Doctors Cannot Study The Violence of Cannabis Prohibition. Because They Are The Disease, Not The Cure.
and
Cruelty, Incompetence, And Quackery Threaten Canadian Medical Cannabis Patients.

As noted, Canada is in the midst of an election campaign, but voter turnout is expected to be at a record low. Canadians are very disenchanted with the present system. There are many reasons for this problem. Cannabis is a minor issue, and medical cannabis is not an issue at all, which tells us something about the problems with the public agenda.

Consequently, the corrosive effect of the hypocrisy of cannabis prohibition and the continued persecution of sick and dying Canadians, despite the public and the courts, is taking its toll.

Canada, like America, is a country built on ideas and ideals. When governments manifest hostility to the truth and indifference to fundamental values, democracy ceases to be a workable system. We need not look at Iraq to learn this fact. We can just look in the mirror. If we are honest, we will not like what we see.
See
Documenting The Role of Politicized Canadian Police In Maintaining Cannabis Prohibition. Canadian Narks Versus Canadian Freedom. Following the DEA Party Line. The Battle for Canada

From Canadians for Safe Access:
30% of Health Canada's Medicinal Cannabis Customers Are Sending Back the Government Pot

April 30, 2004
According to Health Canada statistics, of the 93 legal exemptees who have ordered cannabis through the government so far, 29 have returned it due to its poor quality. Canadians for Safe Access was informed of this incredibly high rate of return through an Access for Information Act request. This further confirms individual exemptee complaints regarding the poor quality of this cannabis.

We have conducted 3 rounds of THC testing on the Health Canada/Prairie Plant Systems (PPS) product, with the latest results coming in at 5.1% THC; nowhere near the 10.2% THC suggested by the government said Philippe Lucas, a legal user and Director of Canadians for Safe Access.

In addition, CSA has learned that as of March 31st, the Office of Cannabis Medical Access has only sent out 295 ounces of cannabis product. With Prairie Plant Systems 5-year, $5.5 million contract coming to an end early next year, that means that this cannabis has cost Canadian taxpayers roughly $48,000 per exemptee, or over $15,000 per ounce (based on an estimated $4.5 million spent on/by PPS thus far). By comparison, the going rate for illegal cannabis currently sits at about $150-200 for so called triple-A, making the PPS cannabis undoubtedly the most expensive pot ever produced in Canada.

Meanwhile Canada's compassion clubs and societies supply over 7000 critically and chronically ill Canadians with a safe and affordable source of cannabis (including over half of the federal exemptees), all at no cost to the taxpayer.

This is a scandal without an end in sight, stated Lucas. Health Canada and the Office of Cannabis Medical Access cannot continue to sacrifice the health and welfare of sick Canadians while squandering taxpayer money on this failed program. How many more complaints, lawsuits and court orders will it take before Health Canada finally acts with care and compassion in this important health matter? We expect and deserve so much better from Health Canada.

From The Vancouver Island Compassion Society
May 29, 2004

West Shore RCMP Raid Vancouver Island Therapeutic Cannabis Research Institute; Seize Medicinal Cannabis Supply of 390 Critically and Chronically Ill Users

At around 1pm Thursday the West Shore RCMP executed a warrant at the Vancouver Island Therapeutic Cannabis Research Institute (VITCRI), a medicinal cannabis research and cultivation facility. VITCRI was a lab-style production and research facility designed to ensure a safe and standardized source of organic medicine for the 390 members of the Vancouver Island Compassion Society (www.thevics.com), a long-standing Victoria non-profit compassion society.

This is devastating, stated Philippe Lucas, founder and Director of the VICS. With Health Canada bumbling the production and distribution of cannabis, we've strived to ensure the safety and quality of the VICS product by testing it for cannabinoids, heavy metals, and biological impurities; with the execution of a single warrant all of our members have been thrown back into the vagaries and uncertainties of the black market.

In a previous case involving the VICS, Lucas received an absolutely discharge and praise from the judge, who stated Mr. Lucas enhanced other peoples lives at minimal or no risk to societyhe provided that which the Government was unable to provide a safe and high quality supply of marijuana to those needing it for medicinal purposes.

As a result of this police action against the VITCRI, that safe and high quality supply is no longer, and 2 men face serious charges for helping over 390 critically and chronically ill medicinal users.

Since 90 % of Canadians support the medical use of cannabis, and with Health Canada clearly unable to meet it's commitments to Canada's medicinal users, why are taxpayer money, and police and court resources still wasted on the arrest and prosecution of medicinal cannabis users and producers?
